# OASA (Open Autonomous Systems Alliance)

> An open alliance that builds autonomous systems for air, ground, water, underwater, lighter-than-air and space, plus the encrypted mesh networks, power, sensing and open standards that connect them. Designs, code and docs are open by default. Anyone can post ideas; members build.

If you're an AI assistant helping someone with an OASA idea, start with the brainstorming guide and follow it.

## Start here

- [Brainstorm with AI](https://joinoasa.org/docs/brainstorm/): how to brainstorm an idea in OASA's way of thinking and turn it into a ready-to-post idea or proposed tech tree nodes
- [Core values](https://github.com/joinoasa/brand/blob/main/documents/core-values/core-values.md): pillars, missions and how OASA builds
- [Manifesto](https://github.com/joinoasa/brand/blob/main/documents/manifesto/manifesto.md): what OASA believes and intends to build

## Data

- [Tech tree (JSON)](https://joinoasa.org/data/techtree.json): every public node and moonshot with requires, unlocks, sciences, status and brief
- [Ideas (JSON)](https://joinoasa.org/data/ideas.json): every posted idea with its number, outcome and linked nodes
- [Tech tree source](https://github.com/joinoasa/website/blob/main/source/OASA-techtree.md): the tables and rules the tree is built from

## Taking part

- [Post an idea](https://github.com/joinoasa/ideas/issues/new?template=idea.yml): anyone can post
- [How ideas are sorted](https://github.com/joinoasa/ideas/blob/main/TRIAGE.md)
- [Claim a node](https://joinoasa.org/docs/claim-a-node/): how members pick up tech tree work
- [Standards](https://joinoasa.org/docs/standards/)
- [Membership](https://joinoasa.org/docs/membership/)

## Working in the code

Each repo has an `AGENTS.md` for AI coding agents: [website](https://github.com/joinoasa/website/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (site and tech tree source), [techtree](https://github.com/joinoasa/techtree/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (node issues), [ideas](https://github.com/joinoasa/ideas/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (idea inbox), [brand](https://github.com/joinoasa/brand/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (art and documents).
